title: SSO connection configured and tested
assertion: An SSO connection to the firm's identity provider is configured for the claude.ai organization (and the Console organization if one exists) on every verified domain, and a test sign-in succeeded.
evidence_to_collect: Organization and access page showing verified domains and the active SSO connection, plus the dated Test sign-in result.
review_gate: Documented for Team, Enterprise, and Console organizations through a WorkOS SAML flow; Owner or Primary Owner on Team and Enterprise, Admin on Console. Domain verification is a prerequisite. Record the IdP signing certificate expiry: with Require SSO on, an expired certificate locks everyone out until Support restores access.

title: Require SSO for Claude
assertion: Require SSO for Claude is on, so members sign in to claude.ai only through Continue with SSO.
evidence_to_collect: Authentication section showing Require SSO for Claude on, and a synthetic account that cannot use Continue with email.
review_gate: Documented default: SSO is optional and users see both SSO and email sign-in. Once required, personal Free, Pro, Team, or Max accounts on the domain that are not in the SSO app become inaccessible (not deleted), so notify people first. The Primary Owner is not exempt.

title: Require SSO for Console
assertion: Require SSO for Console is on for every Console organization linked to the firm's parent organization.
evidence_to_collect: Console Identity and access page showing Require SSO for Console on, and a synthetic Console user who cannot sign in by email.
review_gate: The Console Identity and access page appears only after Sales enables SSO or a merge links the Console organization to a Team or Enterprise parent. Documented default: SSO optional. If the firm has no Console organization, record the control as not applicable with the account inventory as evidence.

title: Restrict organization creation
assertion: Restrict organization creation is on, so nobody can create a new Claude or Console organization, including a personal account, with a verified firm domain.
evidence_to_collect: Security section of Organization and access showing the toggle on, and a synthetic sign-up with a firm address that is refused.
review_gate: Appears under Security once a domain is verified; Team plans can use it. The default was not stated on the pages read. It is also a prerequisite for domain capture on Enterprise.

title: SCIM directory sync provisioning
assertion: User provisioning is set to SCIM directory sync, so members are added and removed from the identity provider without waiting for a sign-in.
evidence_to_collect: User provisioning section showing SCIM directory sync, the Directory view of synced users, and the preview removal count reviewed before saving.
review_gate: Documented default: Invite only. SCIM is documented for Enterprise and for Console organizations with their own or an Enterprise parent; Team plans cannot use SCIM. On Team, record SCIM as unsupported and rely on JIT plus ANT-07. Saving before every user is assigned in the IdP deprovisions them.

title: Group mappings for role and seat tier
assertion: Enable group mappings is on and every role, including Owner (claude.ai) or Admin (Console), maps to a named IdP group that contains the intended administrators.
evidence_to_collect: Group mapping table, IdP group membership export, and a check that each current Owner or Admin sits in a mapped group.
review_gate: Available with JIT or SCIM. Owners and Admins not in a mapped group are downgraded or removed when mappings are enabled; only the single Primary Owner is exempt from SCIM reconciliation. Under JIT, Custom-role users need manually created groups or they get no permissions.

title: Leaver removal is proven
assertion: A synthetic leaver removed in the identity provider loses access to claude.ai and, where used, the Console, and no longer holds a seat, within the approved window.
evidence_to_collect: Dated leaver exercise: IdP change time, member list before and after, and a failed sign-in attempt.
review_gate: Under SCIM, removal from the IdP app removes the member automatically. Under JIT, unassigning the user only blocks sign-in; the member keeps the seat until an admin removes them, so the offboarding checklist must include manual removal. Removing a member removes their artifact access at the same time.

title: Domain capture is an approved decision
assertion: Migrate accounts using your domain is enabled only through an approved change that verified domain verification, enforced SSO, active JIT or SCIM, and restricted organization creation, or it is off with a dated decision record.
evidence_to_collect: Change record with the four prerequisites checked, the affected-account CSV, the approver, and the claim date, or the dated decision to leave it off.
review_gate: Enterprise only; Team can verify domains but cannot claim accounts. Irreversible: the page calls it a one-way door. Personal accounts get a single 30-day migration window, then are deactivated and paid subscriptions are cancelled with a prorated refund. People not in the IdP are locked out.

title: Organization discoverability off
assertion: Organization discovery is off for every firm domain, so people cannot find and join the organization from the sign-up flow.
evidence_to_collect: Domains list on Organization and access showing Discoverable off for each domain.
review_gate: Documented default: on for new Team organizations, off for new Enterprise and for existing organizations. Unavailable once SSO is enabled, so with ANT-01 in place the evidence is the SSO state. With instant approval, joiners take the lowest seat tier and billing auto-expands. Keep off unless SSO with SCIM or JIT provisioning from the identity provider is in place.

title: Member-to-member invites off
assertion: Member-to-member invites are disabled, so only admins can send invitations.
evidence_to_collect: Admin setting for member-to-member invites shown off, and a synthetic member without the invite option.
review_gate: Documented default: on for new Team organizations, off for Enterprise. Invitees must still use an allowed domain. Keep off unless a named admin approving every invitation, with a monthly member export reconciled to HR records is in place.

title: Invite links off
assertion: The shareable invite link is disabled for the organization.
evidence_to_collect: Organization and access page showing the invite link disabled.
review_gate: Documented default: on for new Team organizations; off for non-SSO Enterprise; unavailable for SSO organizations. Disabling or regenerating invalidates every existing link. Keep off unless a link regenerated after each use and a monthly member export reconciled to HR records is in place.

title: Accountable Primary Owner and Owners
assertion: The Primary Owner and every Owner are named in a private roster approved by the firm, with a documented successor for the Primary Owner, and the Owner count is within the approved number.
evidence_to_collect: Members export filtered to Owner and Primary Owner, compared with the approved roster and succession record.
review_gate: One Primary Owner per organization, which may be a service account. Only Owners and the Primary Owner can change roles, invite or remove Admins and Owners, and manage SSO on Enterprise. Set the intended Primary Owner before enabling SCIM, because the role cannot be assigned by group mapping.

title: Identity and Access Manage reserved
assertion: No custom role grants Identity & Access set to Manage except roles held by named security and IT administrators.
evidence_to_collect: Roles page export of admin permissions per custom role and the groups assigned to each such role.
review_gate: Enterprise only. A role with Identity & Access set to Manage can edit roles and groups, including its own, so it can expand its own access. On Team, record as not applicable: there are no custom roles.

title: Console organization roles are least privilege
assertion: Console organization Admin is held only by named administrators, and members who do not need API keys hold User or Claude Code User rather than Developer or Limited Developer.
evidence_to_collect: Console Members export with roles, compared with an approved list, and workspace membership for each Developer.
review_gate: Six Console roles are documented. Limited Developer and Developer can manage API keys; Admin can do everything and becomes Workspace Admin in every workspace. Organization users and developers must be added to each workspace explicitly. Keep off unless a quarterly API key inventory that maps every active key to an owner and purpose is in place.

title: Tenant Restrictions header
assertion: The firm's proxy injects anthropic-allowed-org-ids with only the firm's organization UUIDs on claude.ai, api.anthropic.com, claude.com, and anthropic.com traffic, overwriting any existing value.
evidence_to_collect: Proxy rule export, a test from the corporate network showing a 403 tenant_restriction_violation for a non-listed organization, and a success for the firm's organization.
review_gate: Documented for Enterprise plans and Console organizations; TLS inspection is required. Covers web, desktop, API key, and OAuth token access. It applies only to traffic that passes through the proxy, so devices off the network are outside it.

title: IP allowlisting
assertion: An IP allowlist containing every approved office, VPN exit, and service range is in force for the Enterprise organization.
evidence_to_collect: Support or account-team confirmation of the configured CIDR ranges, the firm's approved range list, and a blocked test from an unlisted address.
review_gate: Enterprise only and not self-serve: ranges are sent to the Anthropic contact or Support. Omitted ranges can lock users out. The page does not say which surfaces are covered, so test each surface the firm uses. On Team, record as unsupported.

title: No Development Partner Program participation
assertion: The firm has not enrolled any organization in the Development Partner Program, or enrollment is covered by a signed decision naming the data in scope.
evidence_to_collect: Account settings or contract record showing no enrollment, or the signed decision.
review_gate: Documented for commercial offerings (API, Console, Team, Enterprise): Anthropic does not train on chats or coding sessions unless the customer participates in the Development Partner Program; explicit feedback reports may be used. Keep off unless a signed decision by the approver that names the repositories and data in scope and confirms no client obligation forbids it is in place.

title: Firm data stays out of personal Claude accounts
assertion: The acceptable use policy forbids firm or client data in personal Free, Pro, or Max accounts, and staff acknowledgment is recorded.
evidence_to_collect: Policy text, acknowledgment records, and the domain membership export showing personal accounts on firm domains.
review_gate: Consumer accounts follow a different policy: chats and coding sessions may be used for training when the user allows it, when a conversation is flagged for safety review, or when the user opts in to a program. Restrict organization creation (ANT-04), domain capture (ANT-08), and Tenant Restrictions (ANT-15) reduce but do not remove the route.

title: Chat retention period set
assertion: A custom retention period for chats is set in Data and Privacy to the approved number of days.
evidence_to_collect: Data and Privacy settings showing the chat retention period and the approval record for the value.
review_gate: Enterprise only; Primary Owner or Owner. Documented default: retained indefinitely. Minimum 30 days. Deletion at midnight UTC is permanent. It does not apply to Claude Design, Claude Tag, Claude Managed Agents, or features built on Claude Code on the web. Memory is unavailable to organizations with custom retention agreements. On Team, record as unsupported.

title: Project retention period set
assertion: A custom retention period for projects is set in Data and Privacy to the approved number of days.
evidence_to_collect: Data and Privacy settings showing the project retention period.
review_gate: Enterprise only. Project retention always takes precedence for chats inside projects, and by default projects are retained indefinitely, so a chat period alone leaves project chats untouched. On Team, record as unsupported.

title: Zero data retention where an obligation requires it
assertion: Every API organization that processes data under a client obligation requiring zero retention has ZDR enabled by the account team, confirmed in writing for that organization.
evidence_to_collect: Account-team confirmation per organization and the list of client obligations that require it.
review_gate: ZDR is requested through sales and enabled per organization; it does not extend to new organizations. It does not cover the Console and playground, Claude Team and Enterprise product interfaces (except Claude Code on Enterprise with ZDR), or flagged content, which may be kept up to 2 years. Claude Code metrics logging is exempt from ZDR. If no obligation exists, record as not applicable.

title: ZDR-ineligible features are approved before use
assertion: In any organization with ZDR, ZDR-ineligible features (including code execution, Files API, batch processing, agent skills, MCP connector, Managed Agents, and Covered Models) are used only where a written approval accepts their retention.
evidence_to_collect: Usage and Cost API export grouped by feature or cost description, compared with the approval list.
review_gate: The API does not block ineligible features under ZDR; using one steps outside the arrangement for that data. Covered Models require 30-day retention, which a workspace can enable under Privacy controls.

title: Allowed inference geos restricted
assertion: Each Console workspace that handles data with a location obligation sets allowed_inference_geos to ["us"] and default_inference_geo to "us".
evidence_to_collect: Workspace data_residency settings from the Console or Admin API for each in-scope workspace.
review_gate: Documented default for inference_geo: global. Supported on Claude 4.6 and later models; US-only inference is priced at 1.1x. Workspace geo is fixed at creation and "us" is the only option. Not applicable on Bedrock or Google Cloud, where the endpoint sets the region.

title: Claude Code local transcript retention
assertion: Managed settings set cleanupPeriodDays to the approved number of days for local Claude Code session transcripts.
evidence_to_collect: Managed settings source and /status on a sample device showing the managed value.
review_gate: Documented default: 30 days. Transcripts are stored in plaintext under ~/.claude/projects/. A value of 0 fails validation.

title: Public projects off
assertion: Public projects is off, so no project is visible to everyone in the organization by default.
evidence_to_collect: Data and privacy > Sharing showing Public projects off, and a sample former public project now private.
review_gate: Team and Enterprise; Owners, Primary Owners, or an Enterprise custom role with Privacy set to Can manage. Documented default: on. Here public means everyone in the organization, not the internet; turning it off makes existing public projects private. Keep off unless a project owner register reviewed quarterly that lists every organization-wide project and its contents is in place.

title: Project sharing limited by role
assertion: On Enterprise, the Share projects capability is granted only to custom roles whose members need to share projects.
evidence_to_collect: Roles page showing Share projects per role and the groups assigned.
review_gate: Enterprise only; Share projects must be on at organization level first. Documented default for Share projects: on. On Team, record as unsupported and rely on ANT-25 and user guidance.

title: Artifact external sharing off
assertion: External sharing is off in Organization settings > Artifacts, so artifacts cannot be shared with anyone who has the link.
evidence_to_collect: Artifacts settings page showing External sharing off, and the Published artifacts list showing any individually allowed exceptions.
review_gate: Team and Enterprise. The default was not stated on the page read. Turning it off stops existing public links until turned back on, except artifacts allowed individually. Keep off unless a named reviewer approving each externally shared artifact and a monthly review of Published artifacts marked Shared outside is in place.

title: Artifact email invitations outside the organization off
assertion: Email invitations outside your organization is off in Organization settings > Artifacts.
evidence_to_collect: Artifacts settings page showing the toggle off.
review_gate: A separate setting from External sharing. The default was not stated. Turning it off blocks people already invited until it is turned back on; pending invitations expire after 30 days. Keep off unless a sponsor for each outside invitee and a monthly review of outside access under Published artifacts is in place.

title: Code execution network egress restricted
assertion: Allow network egress for code execution and file creation is off or set to package managers only; All domains is not selected.
evidence_to_collect: Capabilities page showing the egress option and any added domains.
review_gate: Documented defaults: Team on with egress to package managers only; new Enterprise on with egress off. (The same page also says network access is disabled by default for Team; confirm on the actual plan.) MCP connectors can still move data regardless of this setting. Keep off unless a reviewed domain allowlist under package managers and specific domains is in place.

title: Organization memory off unless approved
assertion: Memory is off in Organization settings > Capabilities unless a written decision approves it for named populations.
evidence_to_collect: Capabilities page showing the memory toggle, and the decision record if on.
review_gate: Documented default on Team and Enterprise: off, turned on by an Owner. Turning it off deletes every member's memory permanently. Memory follows chat retention and is included in exports; it is unavailable with HIPAA, public-sector, or custom retention agreements. The memory page describes only the organization toggle, while the RBAC page lists memory among features custom roles grant; verify per-role control on the actual plan. Keep off unless a written decision naming the populations allowed memory and a data-handling note that memory follows chat retention and export is in place.

title: Skill and plugin publishing requires review
assertion: The Publishing policy in Plugins & skills is Requires review or Off, not Open.
evidence_to_collect: Plugins & skills Policy tab showing Publishing, and the Requests tab history.
review_gate: Documented starting values: Team Open (Off if Share with organization was already off); Enterprise off, switching to Requires review on October 2, 2026 if unset. Under Open, submissions go to everyone without review. Keep off unless an owner reviewing each submission under Requires review is in place.

title: Skill and plugin security scanning on
assertion: Skill and plugin security scanning is on for the Enterprise organization.
evidence_to_collect: Plugins & skills Policy tab showing scanning on.
review_gate: Enterprise only. Off by default until October 2, 2026, then on by default where available for organizations that have not chosen. Not available with CMEK, ZDR, or HIPAA configurations. On Team, record as unsupported and rely on ANT-31.

title: Claude in Chrome off unless piloted
assertion: Enable for your team in Organization settings > Claude in Chrome is off, or on only for an approved pilot.
evidence_to_collect: Claude in Chrome settings page and, for a pilot, the managed Chrome deployment scope.
review_gate: Team and Enterprise. Documented default: Team on; Enterprise off, turning on by default from September 10, 2026 unless already disabled. Not available to HIPAA organizations; ZDR not supported. The per-role capability applies on Enterprise with custom roles. Keep off unless a pilot group limited by managed Chrome deployment and a restrictive site allowlist is in place.

title: Claude in Chrome site allowlist
assertion: If Claude in Chrome is enabled, a site allowlist limits Claude to named approved sites.
evidence_to_collect: Allowlist and blocklist export from the Claude in Chrome settings page.
review_gate: Anthropic recommends starting with a restrictive allowlist. The same list governs the Cowork built-in browser. Default protections include injection classifiers, blocked high-risk categories, and confirmation for downloads and sensitive input, which the page says do not reduce risk to zero. If Chrome is off, record as not applicable.

title: Directory connectors are approved
assertion: Every connector added to the organization in Organization settings > Connectors appears in the approved connector register with an owner, purpose, and data categories.
evidence_to_collect: Connectors page export compared with the register.
review_gate: Team and Enterprise; Owner or Primary Owner adds connectors. Each user still authenticates individually and inherits their own source-system permissions. Connectors work only in private projects, and chats with synced content cannot be shared.

title: Custom remote MCP connectors reviewed
assertion: Every custom connector added to the organization has a recorded review of the server operator, URL, requested scopes, and tools.
evidence_to_collect: Custom connectors in Organization settings > Connectors compared with review records.
review_gate: On Team and Enterprise only Owners add custom connectors; members then connect individually. The servers are not verified by Anthropic, run from Anthropic's cloud, and may carry hidden instructions or change tool behavior. Keep off unless a written review of the server operator, requested scopes, and tool list, with an owner and review date is in place.

title: Connector write tools need approval or are blocked
assertion: For each connector, organization tool permissions set write and delete tools to Needs approval or Blocked unless a tool-level review approved Always allow.
evidence_to_collect: Tool permissions per connector, grouped by read-only and write/delete categories.
review_gate: Owners on Team and Enterprise set Always allow, Needs approval, or Blocked; users cannot override. On Enterprise the organization policy is the ceiling for role grants; existing roles are seeded at Always allow when connector permissions are enabled and new roles default to Needs approval. Research can invoke connector tools without further approval. Keep off unless a tool-level review showing the tool is read-only or its writes are reversible and logged is in place.

title: Verified-domain connectors restricted to the enterprise
assertion: Restrict verified-domain connectors to your enterprise is on.
evidence_to_collect: Organization and access > Connector domain restriction showing the toggle on, and a failed test connection from a personal Claude account using a firm address.
review_gate: Enterprise only; requires a verified domain. The default was not stated. It does not disconnect existing connections, does not notify admins, and allows the connection when a service does not share identity. On Team, record as unsupported.

title: Desktop extension allowlist on
assertion: The desktop extension allowlist is on and lists only reviewed extensions.
evidence_to_collect: Organization settings > Connectors > Desktop showing the allowlist on and its entries.
review_gate: Team and Enterprise Owners. Documented default: disabled, so users can install any directory extension. Enabling it force-deletes unlisted installs and blocks drag-and-drop MCPB installs. Requires Claude Desktop 0.13.91 or later. It does not stop tampering with local MCP files. Keep off unless the desktop extension allowlist with each allowed extension reviewed is in place.

title: isDesktopExtensionEnabled deployed by MDM
assertion: MDM deploys isDesktopExtensionEnabled with the value the extension decision requires: false where extensions are not used, true only where the allowlist (ANT-39) governs them.
evidence_to_collect: MDM profile or HKLM policy export and the recorded decision.
review_gate: Documented default: true. Machine policy overrides the in-app allowlist; setting this key or isDesktopExtensionDirectoryEnabled to false stops the allowlist populating. macOS domain com.anthropic.claudefordesktop; Windows HKLM\SOFTWARE\Policies\Claude takes priority over HKCU.

title: Local MCP servers disabled in Claude Desktop
assertion: MDM sets isLocalDevMcpEnabled to false on managed devices.
evidence_to_collect: MDM profile or HKLM export and a device check showing local MCP servers unavailable.
review_gate: Documented default: true. The Chrome admin page also names this key as the way to stop Claude Desktop driving the browser. Keep off unless a reviewed list of local MCP servers deployed by IT and a device check that no others are configured is in place.

title: Cowork workspace folders restricted
assertion: MDM sets allowedWorkspaceFolders to the approved folder paths that users may mount to Cowork.
evidence_to_collect: MDM profile or HKLM export listing the paths.
review_gate: Documented default: unrestricted. If Cowork is disabled with secureVmFeaturesEnabled false (default true), record the reason and the key value instead.

title: Claude Desktop pinned to the firm organization
assertion: MDM sets forceLoginOrgUUID for Claude Desktop to the firm's organization UUIDs.
evidence_to_collect: MDM profile or HKLM export and a failed sign-in with a personal account.
review_gate: Documented default: null. A single UUID also pre-selects the organization; an array accepts any listed organization. The Chrome admin page documents a Chrome enterprise policy of the same name for the extension.

title: Claude Desktop updates are not left to drift
assertion: disableAutoUpdates is false (default) unless MDM manages Claude Desktop versions, in which case the MDM update ring is documented.
evidence_to_collect: MDM profile or HKLM export and version report across devices.
review_gate: Documented defaults: disableAutoUpdates false; autoUpdaterEnforcementHours 72 (range 1 to 72) before a forced restart to apply a prepared update.

title: Organization instructions editable only by named Owners
assertion: Only the named Owners and Primary Owner in the approved roster can view or edit claude.ai organization instructions.
evidence_to_collect: Members export of Owner and Primary Owner roles compared with the roster (ANT-12).
review_gate: Team and Enterprise. Organization instructions apply to every conversation, take precedence over individual instructions, and are visible only to Owners and above. Maximum 3,000 characters; changes can take up to an hour.

title: Organization instructions are versioned and reviewed
assertion: The current organization instructions text is stored in the firm's version control, and every change went through a reviewed change before it was pasted in.
evidence_to_collect: Repository history for the instructions file compared with the live text on Organization and access.
review_gate: There is no native version history on the page read, so this is a process control. Instructions cannot disable built-in safety behavior; prioritization is prompt-level and may vary in edge cases, so test after each change.

title: Server-managed settings changed only through review
assertion: Claude Code server-managed settings are edited only by named Owners, and each change matches a reviewed change record.
evidence_to_collect: Managed settings page content, the Owner roster, Compliance API audit events for setting changes, and change records.
review_gate: Team and Enterprise; only Owner or Primary Owner can view or edit. Clients fetch at startup and hourly. The page calls them a client-side control, not a security boundary: on unmanaged devices users can bypass them. They cannot deliver managed-mcp.json.

title: Fail closed when remote policy is missing
assertion: Managed settings set forceRemoteSettingsRefresh to true, so Claude Code exits when it cannot freshly fetch server-managed settings at startup.
evidence_to_collect: Managed settings source and a test start with the fetch blocked.
review_gate: Managed-only key. Without it, a failed fetch continues on cache or with no remote policy (fail-open).

title: Endpoint policy deployed from a reviewed source
assertion: managed-settings.json, the macOS com.anthropic.claudecode profile, or the Windows HKLM policy on every managed device is generated from a reviewed repository, and no device relies on HKCU for enforcement.
evidence_to_collect: Repository commit for the policy, MDM deployment report, and /status Setting sources on sample devices.
review_gate: File paths: /Library/Application Support/ClaudeCode/, /etc/claude-code/, C:\Program Files\ClaudeCode\. HKCU is user-writable and is a convenience default, not an enforcement channel. By default the highest-priority managed source wins and sources do not merge.

title: Managed CLAUDE.md deployed from a reviewed source
assertion: The managed policy CLAUDE.md on managed devices matches the reviewed version in the firm's repository.
evidence_to_collect: Hash comparison of the deployed file with the repository version on sample devices.
review_gate: Managed CLAUDE.md cannot be excluded by users and loads in every session, but it is guidance to the model, not enforcement; pair it with permission and sandbox settings.

title: Members cannot add their own permission rules
assertion: Managed settings set allowManagedPermissionRulesOnly to true.
evidence_to_collect: Managed settings source and a test showing a user-level allow rule ignored.
review_gate: Managed-only key. Arrays such as permissions.deny otherwise merge from every source, so developers can extend but not remove managed entries. It does not enforce the MCP allowlist.

title: Repository instruction files are reviewed
assertion: Changes to CLAUDE.md, .claude/rules/, AGENTS.md, and .claude/settings.json in firm repositories require an approving review before merge.
evidence_to_collect: Repository ruleset or CODEOWNERS entry covering these paths and a sample merged change with review.
review_gate: Project files are shared through source control and load into every session in that repository; project settings cannot set auto or bypassPermissions as the starting mode.

title: API system prompts live in reviewed code
assertion: System prompts for firm applications that call the Claude API, including computer use agents, are stored in version control and changed only through reviewed pull requests.
evidence_to_collect: Repository location of each system prompt and review history.
review_gate: A process control: the API accepts whatever system prompt the caller sends. The computer use page documents a system prompt section and warns that content can override instructions.

title: bypassPermissions mode disabled
assertion: Managed settings set permissions.disableBypassPermissionsMode to "disable".
evidence_to_collect: Managed settings source and a test where --dangerously-skip-permissions is rejected.
review_gate: Documented default: unset. bypassPermissions is meant for isolated containers and VMs only and offers no protection against prompt injection. Keep off unless an isolated container or VM with no production credentials and no firm data beyond the task is in place.

title: Auto mode is an approved choice
assertion: Managed settings set permissions.disableAutoMode to "disable" unless the approved register allows auto mode for the population.
evidence_to_collect: Managed settings source and the register entry.
review_gate: Documented default: unset. With v2.1.283 or later, auto mode is the built-in starting mode for interactive terminal and VS Code sessions; a server-side classifier reviews actions. Keep off unless sandboxing enforced by managed settings and deny rules for secret files is in place.

title: Deny rules protect secret files
assertion: Managed permissions.deny includes rules for the firm's secret files, such as .env files and credential directories.
evidence_to_collect: Managed settings deny list and a test where Claude cannot read a synthetic secret file.
review_gate: Deny is evaluated before ask and allow, applies in every mode including bypassPermissions, and merges from all sources. Denying WebFetch does not stop curl in Bash; sandboxing closes that gap.

title: Only managed hooks run
assertion: Managed settings set allowManagedHooksOnly to true.
evidence_to_collect: Managed settings source and a test where a project hook does not run.
review_gate: Managed-only key. Hooks from plugins that managed settings force-enable and Agent SDK hooks still run. Pair with allowedHttpHookUrls if HTTP hooks are used (default unset, any URL allowed).

title: MCP server allowlist
assertion: Managed settings define allowedMcpServers matching approved servers by serverUrl or serverCommand, or a managed-mcp.json deploys the fixed set.
evidence_to_collect: Managed settings or managed-mcp.json content and a test where an unlisted server is blocked.
review_gate: Documented default: without these, users can add any server. serverName entries are not a security control. managed-mcp.json takes exclusive control but cannot be delivered through server-managed settings. deniedMcpServers merges from every scope and wins over the allowlist.

title: Only the managed MCP allowlist counts
assertion: Managed settings set allowManagedMcpServersOnly to true.
evidence_to_collect: Managed settings source and a test where a user-level allowedMcpServers entry is ignored.
review_gate: Managed-only key. deniedMcpServers still merges from all sources.

title: Sandboxing enabled
assertion: Managed settings set sandbox.enabled to true for managed devices.
evidence_to_collect: Managed settings source and /sandbox status on sample macOS, Linux, and WSL2 devices.
review_gate: Documented default: false. Supported on macOS, Linux, and WSL2; native Windows is not supported, so Windows users need WSL2 or a compensating control.

title: Fail when the sandbox cannot start
assertion: Managed settings set sandbox.failIfUnavailable to true.
evidence_to_collect: Managed settings source and a test on a device missing a sandbox dependency.
review_gate: Documented default: false; without it Claude Code warns and runs commands unsandboxed.

title: No unsandboxed retry
assertion: Managed settings set sandbox.allowUnsandboxedCommands to false.
evidence_to_collect: Managed settings source and a test where dangerouslyDisableSandbox is ignored.
review_gate: Documented default: true, which lets Claude retry a blocked command outside the sandbox. Keep off unless a named approver for each excluded command recorded in managed settings is in place.

title: Sandbox network limited to managed domains
assertion: Managed settings set sandbox.network.allowManagedDomainsOnly to true with a reviewed allowedDomains list.
evidence_to_collect: Managed settings source and a test where a sandboxed command cannot reach an unlisted domain.
review_gate: Managed-only key; other domains are blocked without prompting.

title: Plugin marketplaces restricted
assertion: Managed settings set strictKnownMarketplaces to the approved marketplace sources.
evidence_to_collect: Managed settings source and a test adding an unlisted marketplace.
review_gate: Managed-only. Documented default: unset, so users can add any marketplace; an empty array blocks every source including the official Anthropic marketplace. blockedMarketplaces is available as a denylist.

title: Sideload flags rejected
assertion: Managed settings set disableSideloadFlags to true.
evidence_to_collect: Managed settings source and a test where --mcp-config is rejected at startup.
review_gate: Managed-only key rejecting --plugin-dir, --plugin-url, --agents, and --mcp-config.

title: Claude Code login pinned to the firm organization
assertion: A managed source on each device sets forceLoginOrgUUID to the firm's organization UUIDs.
evidence_to_collect: MDM or file policy and a failed login with a personal account.
review_gate: Only a managed source enforces the organization pin; when set, sessions using ANTHROPIC_API_KEY, ANTHROPIC_AUTH_TOKEN, or apiKeyHelper are blocked at startup. Server-managed settings cannot redirect a first login, so deploy through MDM or file. forceLoginMethod (default unset) restricts the account type.

title: Remote Control governed
assertion: Remote Control is off in Claude Code admin settings, or on only with a recorded approval, and disableRemoteControl is true on devices outside the approval.
evidence_to_collect: Claude Code admin settings page and managed settings for excluded devices.
review_gate: On Team and Enterprise an Owner enables or disables Remote Control and cloud sessions organization-wide. The organization default was not stated on the pages read. disableRemoteControl defaults to false. Keep off unless a named list of approved users and devices and Remote Control sessions reviewed monthly is in place.

title: Cloud environments keep Trusted network access
assertion: Every organization-shared cloud environment uses None or Trusted network access, and any Full or Custom environment has a recorded approval.
evidence_to_collect: Cloud environments page in admin settings listing each environment and its access level.
review_gate: Documented default: Trusted (package registries, GitHub, cloud SDKs). Owners manage organization-shared environments and the default. Each session runs in an isolated VM and GitHub credentials stay in an Anthropic proxy. Keep off unless a documented need, no production credentials in the environment, and session review by the repository owner is in place.

title: Computer use runs isolated
assertion: Every firm application using the computer use tool runs it in a dedicated VM or container with minimal privileges, no stored credentials, an internet allowlist, and human confirmation for consequential actions.
evidence_to_collect: Architecture record per application and a test showing the environment cannot reach an unlisted domain.
review_gate: An API tool, not an admin setting. Anthropic lists these precautions; injection classifiers scan screenshots, and opting out requires Support. Content on screen can override instructions. Keep off unless a dedicated VM or container with minimal privileges, a domain allowlist, and human confirmation for consequential actions is in place.

title: Organization spend limit set
assertion: A self-set monthly spend limit below the tier cap is configured in Console Settings > Billing.
evidence_to_collect: Billing page showing the limit and the approved value.
review_gate: Tier caps: Start $500, Build $1,000, Scale $200,000, Custom none. Reaching a self-set limit returns HTTP 400; reaching the tier cap pauses usage until the first of the next month (HTTP 429).

title: Workspace spend limits set
assertion: Every workspace other than the Default Workspace has a monthly spend limit and alert thresholds.
evidence_to_collect: Spend limits tab for each workspace.
review_gate: Workspace limits can be lower but not higher than the organization's; unset limits match the organization. The Default Workspace cannot carry limits, so keep production keys out of it. Rate limits per model tier are set on the adjacent tab. The Claude Code workspace is the only one with per-user monthly spend limits.

title: Team and Enterprise usage credits capped
assertion: If usage credits are on, spend limits are set at organization level and, where needed, group or member level.
evidence_to_collect: Admin settings > Usage showing limits.
review_gate: The seat allowance is the default ceiling; usage credits let members continue past it. On Enterprise, individual limits override group limits and the organization limit is the hard ceiling.

title: Identity-backed API keys
assertion: Every active Console API key is a personal key or service account key; no legacy workspace key remains.
evidence_to_collect: Admin API List API Keys export showing principal for each active key.
review_gate: Workspace keys belong to no one and keep working after their creator leaves; personal keys are archived when the user is removed. Anthropic describes workspace keys as legacy.

title: API keys expire
assertion: No active Console API key or Admin API key has expiration Never, and the organization maximum expiration policy is set where available.
evidence_to_collect: List API Keys export with expires_at for each active key.
review_gate: Choices: 3 hours, 1 day, 7 days, 30 days, custom, or Never. Expiration is fixed at creation. A maximum expiration policy removes Never, but the pages read do not say where it is configured; ask the account team. Keep off unless a secrets manager entry with a named owner and a recorded rotation date at most 90 days out is in place.

title: Workload Identity Federation for automated workloads
assertion: Production and CI workloads that call the Claude API authenticate with Workload Identity Federation rather than a static key.
evidence_to_collect: Service accounts, federation issuers, and federation rules in the Console, and each workload's configuration.
review_gate: Supports AWS, Google Cloud, and standards-compliant OIDC issuers. The trust chain is only as strong as the IdP configuration. If no automated workload exists, record as not applicable with the inventory as evidence.

title: Admin API keys held by named admins
assertion: Each Admin API key maps to a named admin and purpose, and unused Admin keys are deleted.
evidence_to_collect: Settings > Admin keys list compared with the register.
review_gate: Only admin-role members create Console Admin keys (sk-ant-admin01-), which have no scopes and carry full Admin API access. The Admin API can read, rename, and change key status but cannot create keys or remove admins.

title: Leaked key response is rehearsed
assertion: A runbook to disable, then delete, a suspected leaked key has been exercised within the review window, and keys are rotated at the approved interval.
evidence_to_collect: Dated exercise record and key creation dates.
review_gate: Disable is reversible (status inactive); Delete is permanent (archived). GitHub secret scanning reports keys in public repositories and Anthropic deactivates them, which does not cover private repositories or other leak routes. The best-practice page suggests rotating every 90 days and separate keys per environment.

title: Audit logs exported and retained
assertion: An Owner exports the claude.ai audit log at least monthly and the export is stored in the firm's evidence store beyond 180 days.
evidence_to_collect: Export dates and storage location for the last three exports, plus a retrieved sample event.
review_gate: Enterprise only. Each export covers 180 days and the link lasts 24 hours; titles and content are excluded. CMEK organizations use the Compliance API instead. On Team, record as unsupported.

title: Compliance API enabled by the Primary Owner
assertion: The Primary Owner has enabled the Compliance API and a monitoring integration pulls the activity feed.
evidence_to_collect: Organization settings > API showing the API on, and the integration's last successful pull.
review_gate: Enterprise only, excluding Public Sector. Only the Primary Owner can enable it. It excludes Claude Code cloud sessions, Claude Code through the Claude Platform, and Bedrock or Google Cloud sessions. The activity feed is retained 6 years.

title: Compliance and analytics keys least privilege
assertion: Each claude.ai API key carries only the scopes its integration needs, and delete:compliance_user_data and write scopes exist only on keys with a named owner and purpose.
evidence_to_collect: Keys list on Organization settings > API with scopes, compared with the register.
review_gate: Scopes are fixed at creation. read:org_audit gives one read-only scope for audit integrations. Owners can create Compliance-scope keys for their own organization; the Primary Owner can create keys across linked organizations.
